Links to track external dependencies.

Best latest forks:
- [ImGuiNotify](https://github.com/TyomaVader/ImGuiNotify/tree/Dev)
- [imgui_markdown](https://github.com/enkisoftware/imgui_markdown) - this is to be deprecated, due to the parser being extremely limited.
- [imgui_md]([https://github.com/enkisoftware/imgui_md](https://github.com/mekhontsev/imgui_md)) - I think it's based on imgui_markdown, but uses MD4C (super-fast) markdown parser.
